label: The binary counter
subgoals: Count the bits flipped by each increment
Sum the flips over the whole sequence
Compare the total with 2 times the number of increments

label: Doubling hash tables
subgoals: Find the sizes at which the table grows
Sum the copies made at each growth
Bound the total by a constant times the inserts

label: Cost per operation
subgoals: Add the direct cost and the copy cost
Divide by the number of operations
Read the quotient as the amortized cost
